subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new opt-in `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` config surface for preinstalled sandbox skills, or should this be a backend capability/design follow-up on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97638?
rationale: The patch is not only a bug fix; it creates a durable config contract and changes the sandbox skill-read invariant for operators who enable it.

options.title: Approve after targeted repair
options.body: Accept the opt-in config direction, but require the remote-guidance prompt fix and focused regression coverage before merge.

options.title: Move to backend capability design
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the linked issue as the canonical design item if sandbox backends should declare preinstalled skill support instead of adding a user config flag.

options.title: Decline core surface
options.body: Close or rework the PR if maintainers want to keep core sandbox skill materialization mandatory and leave custom deployments to backend-specific packaging.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted repair
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in config direction, but require the remote-guidance prompt fix and focused regression coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the materialized sandbox skill behavior this option changes.
